I’m a licensed psychologist and postdoctoral researcher at Karolinska Institutet, where I work at the Centre for Psychiatry Research in the Department of Clinical Neuroscience and the [Obsessive-Compulsive and Related Disorders Across the Lifespan](https://ki.se/en/research/research-areas-centres-and-networks/research-groups/obsessive-compulsive-and-related-disorders-across-the-lifespan-david-mataix-cols-research-group) research group.

My current research focuses on just-in-time relapse prevention following treatment for obsessive-compulsive disorder in children and adolescents.

My previous research has focused on adult ADHD, work-related mental health, and internet-delivered psychological interventions.

I received my PhD in Psychology from Stockholm University in 2026. I also serve as an Associate Editor for [*Cognitive Behaviour Therapy*](https://www.tandfonline.com/journals/sbeh20).
